title: herdr-peers debate ballots (ballots-v1)
description: What `herdr-peers debate tally` reads: the options a panel ranks and/or the items it gives verdicts on, and one ballot per voter. A voter named `lead` is always left out (the lead never votes). Producers may add keys within a schema version; consumers must ignore unknown keys.

items.description: Items of a draft package that receive a verdict (V1, D1, ...).

voter.description: The voting pane (w1:p2) or a lane name; unique.

ranking.description: Options best first; may be partial (unranked options earn 0 Borda points and lose every duel against a ranked one).

items.description: Item id -> verdict (ACCEPT, AMEND, REJECT, KEEP, REVERSE, ...). A missing item counts as ABSTAIN.
